entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What the...!? You made the same mistake[n]last time! What're you doing!?
entries.uk: Що за?!. Ти й минулого разу так[n]само схибив! Що ти робиш?!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Don't you get it!? You can't just[n]shoot all over the place!
entries.uk: Ти що, не розумієш?! Не можна[n]просто палити куди попало!

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: The King's so awesome at that game.
entries.uk: Король у цій грі просто неймовірний.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: ...Yeah, but he's got such a bad attitude.

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: It's like he's bipolar.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: I wonder how long that high schooler's[n]gonna be able to keep up...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Gahhh! You haven't gotten better at all![n]When are you gonna learn!?
entries.uk: Та-а-а! Ти анітрохи не покращав![n]Коли ти вже навчишся?!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...It's really late.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks to you taking so long to[n]figure it out...
entries.uk: А все тому, що до тебе[n]так довго доходить...

entries.en: Sorry...
Don't compare me to you.[clr 27]
Praise would be encouraging.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...It's kinda weird hearing that from[n]someone older than me.
entries.uk: ...Якось дивно чути таке[n]від старшого за мене.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah, you're right.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You're kind of a simpleton, huh?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I've always been good at shooting games...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I absolutely NEVER wanna lose at[n]Gun About.
entries.uk: Але в «Ґан Ебаут» я НІЗАЩО[n]не хочу програвати.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So I guess I tend to get all heated up[n]about it...

entries.speaker: Calm Employee
entries.en: It's time for all the elementary school kids[n]to go home.

entries.speaker: Calm Employee
entries.en: Do you understand, little boy?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Shut up.

entries.speaker: Calm Employee
entries.en: Do I need to call your mom?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Fine. I'll leave, all right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: *sigh*
Let's go.
What a rude employee.[clr 27]
Something bothering you?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Yeah. We're done for today.[n]Not that I wanna go home though.
entries.uk: ...Ага. На сьогодні все.[n]Хоч додому я й не хочу.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Seriously.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I... really wanted to keep playing.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I just don't wanna go home.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...My house is so boring.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No one's ever there and there's never[n]anything to do.
entries.uk: Там ніколи нікого немає[n]і геть нічого робити.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Adults and high schoolers are so lucky.[n]They get to play all night long.
entries.uk: Дорослим і старшокласникам щастить.[n]Можуть грати хоч цілу ніч.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Having that much time helps you get[n]stronger...
entries.uk: Коли маєш стільки часу,[n]легше стати сильнішим...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I wish I could play all day instead of[n]going to school. I'd never lose another[n]game...
entries.uk: ...От би грати цілий день, а не ходити[n]до школи. Я б більше ніколи[n]не програв...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I need to get really strong, like the[n]Phantom Thieves.
entries.uk: ...Мені треба стати дуже сильним,[n]як Фантомні Злодії.

entries.en: Are they strong?
Do you admire them?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Are you kidding!? They're so strong that[n]nobody can defeat them!
entries.uk: Жартуєш?! Вони такі сильні,[n]що їх ніхто не здолає!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Of course I do! I wanna be just as strong[n]as they are!
entries.uk: Аякже! Я хочу бути таким[n]самим сильним, як вони!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I believe in the Phantom Thieves and[n]their strength.
entries.uk: Я вірю у Фантомних Злодіїв[n]і в їхню силу.

entries.en: So do I.
They're more than strong.
I'll let them know.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's because you're a fan, like me!
entries.uk: Це тому, що ти фанат, як і я!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Isn't the fact that they're super strong[n]enough for you?
entries.uk: Хіба тобі мало того,[n]що вони суперсильні?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...That'd be great! Thanks!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Seriously though, I can't stop[n]thinking about that employee.[n]He was super annoying, huh?
entries.uk: Але серйозно, той працівник[n]мені з голови не йде.[n]Він страшенно бісив, скажи?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If he says something again, I might[n]just have to use that move on him.
entries.uk: Якщо він іще щось бовкне, я, може,[n]застосую на ньому той прийом.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The one I taught you, remember?[n]You should use it sometime.
entries.uk: Той, якого я тебе навчив, пам'ятаєш?[n]Спробуй його колись.

entries.en: I feel like my bond with[n]Shinya is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, it's just a move in the game, so[n]it won't work against actual people...
entries.uk: Хоча це лише прийом із гри, тож[n]на справжніх людях він не спрацює...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I wish it did. Then I'd be strong in real life.
entries.uk: ...А шкода. Тоді я був би сильним[n]і в реальному житті.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I need to be able to win in real life...
entries.uk: Мені треба вміти перемагати[n]в реальному житті...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I'm gonna head home.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Later. Say hi to the Phantom Thieves[n]for me!
entries.uk: Бувай. Передавай від мене[n]привіт Фантомним Злодіям!
